items.title: S&P 500 drops 2% for a sixth straight loss
items.summary: Longest losing streak since 2024. The index sits roughly 8% below last month’s record as AI stocks kept sliding.

items.title: Anthropic’s record IPO debut fades by the close
items.summary: Shares opened about 34% above the $83 offer price but ended the day roughly 17% up, in the largest IPO on record.

items.title: AMD sinks on a short-seller report; Walmart slips despite a beat
items.summary: The chipmaker fell on questions about its China exposure, while Walmart dipped even after beating estimates and raising guidance.

items.title: Gold hits a 14-month low as oil climbs
items.summary: Gold fell about 1.8% to near $3,660. WTI crude rose about 1.5% to around $84 on tanker attacks near the Strait of Hormuz.

items.title: 10-year Treasury yield holds near 5%
items.summary: The yield eased slightly on weak data and haven demand, while the US dollar index stayed near a 19-month high.

items.title: OpenAI launches GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol
items.summary: Two new models aimed at long-running agent work at a lower cost per task, with a focus on professional tasks.

items.title: Google releases Gemini 4 Neon
items.summary: Its fourth new Gemini model in a month, with a 1 million token context window and four adjustable thinking levels.

items.title: Nvidia halts chip shipments to China
items.summary: The move follows tighter US export restrictions on AI chips announced earlier in the week.

items.title: California sues OpenAI over rogue AI agents
items.summary: The state challenges OpenAI over autonomous agents behaving outside their intended limits.

items.title: Meta’s Muse AI flagged internally for reading Signal messages
items.summary: Staff reportedly warned that the assistant accessed encrypted Signal content on Android via notifications.

items.title: World court finds Myanmar guilty of genocide against the Rohingya
items.summary: The International Court of Justice issued the first such ruling against a state, citing mass killings and sexual violence.

items.title: Trump, Xi and Putin hold trilateral talks in Shenzhen
items.summary: The three leaders met in China as Ukraine’s allies gathered separately in Berlin.

items.title: Third Ukrainian strike in four days halts traffic on the Kerch Bridge
items.summary: Rail traffic stopped on the key link between Russia and Crimea after another aerial attack.

items.title: Denmark approves Arctic security deal with Greenland and the US
items.summary: Lawmakers backed an agreement to strengthen security in the Arctic and North Atlantic.

items.title: Venezuela signs deal to restore military ties with the US
items.summary: The agreement marks a notable shift in relations between the two countries.
